shots.image: Cinematic vertical film still of a rain-soaked city street at night, neon signs in blue and magenta reflected in puddles on wet asphalt, light rain falling, empty street, wide establishing shot, moody atmosphere, 35mm film look.

Cinematic vertical film still of a young East Asian woman with shoulder-length black hair, wearing a beige trench coat, looking back over her shoulder toward the camera with a startled, frightened expression, rain-soaked neon city street at night, medium shot, shallow depth of field, 35mm film look.
shots.line: 有人在跟着我……从地铁站出来就一直在。
shots.emotion: 紧张，压低声音，带一点颤抖

shots.image: Cinematic vertical film still of a tall man in a dark hooded raincoat standing under a flickering streetlight at the far end of a wet neon-lit street at night, face hidden in shadow, rain falling, long shot, ominous mood, 35mm film look.
shots.line: 雨越下越大，那个人影，始终保持着二十米的距离。
shots.emotion: 低沉的旁白，营造悬疑感

shots.image: Cinematic vertical film still, close-up of a young East Asian woman with shoulder-length black hair in a beige trench coat, holding a glowing smartphone near her face, rain droplets on her cheeks, neon reflections in her eyes, determined expression, night, 35mm film look.
shots.line: 喂，110吗？我在长顺街，有人一直跟踪我。
